title: Query Expansion Is More Than Generation: Improving Dense Retrieval through Better Integration
abstract: arXiv:2608.25521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate query expansions without task-specific training, yet the same expansions often make a frozen dense retriever worse. We identify an underexplored factor: prior work has often focused on what text is generated, while how generated text is incorporated into dense retrievers has received less systematic attention. By holding generated expansions fixed, we show that performance degradation can often be attributed to the integration method itself. We introduce AnchorQE, a training-free method that separately encodes the original query and its expansion before interpolating them. The interpolation factor is estimated using an unsupervised online strategy that operates over a small part of the unlabeled test stream. translated_title: 查询扩展不仅仅是生成：通过更好集成提升稠密检索
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以在无需任务特定训练的情况下生成查询扩展，但相同的扩展往往会使冻结的稠密检索器性能变差。我们识别出一个未被充分探索的因素：先前的工作通常关注生成什么文本，而生成的文本如何整合到稠密检索器中却受到较少的系统性关注。通过保持生成的扩展固定不变，我们表明性能下降通常可以归因于集成方法本身。我们引入AnchorQE，一种无需训练的方法，该方法分别编码原始查询及其扩展，然后进行插值。插值因子使用一种无监督的在线策略估计，该策略作用于未标记测试流的一小部分。直观上，我们的策略仅在扩展既检索能力强且与原始查询的检索证据一致时，才赋予高扩展信任度。我们展示了AnchorQE改进了检索性能。
tldr: 本文提出AnchorQE，一种无需训练的查询扩展集成方法，通过分别编码原始查询和扩展并基于无监督在线策略插值，解决了LLM生成的扩展在稠密检索中性能下降的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AnchorQE, a training-free query expansion integration method that separately encodes the original query and expansion with an unsupervised online interpolation strategy, addressing performance degradation in dense retrieval caused by LLM-generated expansions.
